prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one premium SERVER-LIMITED mercenary collectible card FRAME ONLY, a genuinely transparent 1024 x 1536 RGBA PNG, portrait 2:3.
Create a new, prestigious collector-grade design with a decisive silhouette and beautifully crafted high-end Korean fantasy game UI painting. This should immediately feel rarer than an ordinary SS card at small size. No character or illustration inside it.
Design: substantial sculpted obsidian-black enamel chassis with deeply layered champagne-gold and pale platinum forged edges, disciplined symmetric architectural geometry. A magnificent distinctive top-center insignia: a dark faceted precious seal held in a V-shaped gold prong, with broad segmented metallic laurel/wing blades sweeping into the two upper corners, three stepped spear-like crown peaks. Strong negative spaces between crest pieces; no stock royal crown icon. An integrated rich dark bottom nameplate, wide enough for a Korean name, with stepped metallic buttresses and an elegant central diamond seal below it. Sculptural corner brackets and continuous beveled side rails with restrained inset engraving. Materials must feel weighty and exclusive: polished gold ridges, dark recessed enamel, satin platinum, tiny controlled cool-white gemstone highlights. Clear large shapes and hierarchy; detailed craftsmanship, no visual clutter.
Composition: straight-on orthographic flat UI asset; exact left/right symmetry; complete frame visible, not tilted. Outer ornament fits within x=18..1006 and y=12..1524. Large CLEAR RECTANGULAR TRANSPARENT aperture x=96..928 and y=144..1392 (832 x 1248, 2:3). This opening must be completely empty true-alpha, no inner background, no gradient, no tinted glass. Keep all metal, shadows and glow outside that rectangular opening. Face/body/weapon artwork will be placed inside later. Long side rails occupy roughly x=26..96 and x=928..998. Rich top architecture is above y=144. The bottom blank nameplate occupies approximately x=230..794, y=1402..1488. Bottom plate has a blank dark horizontal center with no decoration over its writing area. Small blank top plaque at y=103..132 may hold a separate UI label.
Lighting: precise soft upper-left studio highlights painted into the metal, deep local bevel shadows. Restrained prestigious contrast and realistic material depth in polished 2D game illustration, not a cheap shiny plastic render.
Text: NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO RANK, NO LOGO, NO WATERMARK. Do not draw a checkerboard, a card back, a scene, or any solid backing. Actual alpha transparency throughout the center AND outside the silhouette. The expensive frame itself is opaque. No wispy light trails or colorful neon outlines. No generic thin sci-fi rectangle, no narrow silver prism border, no rainbow gradient, no overly fragile filigree. Deliver only this one fully finished transparent frame.
